div.span:
No fact without a verifiable source quote. Facts whose quote cannot be found are flagged or dropped, never trusted.
Model output never decides escalation or eligibility. Fallback never skips quote verification.
Every call is logged: provider, model, prompt version, tokens, cost, latency, validation status.
